requires: Actual93 frozen source, independent review, then root actual isolated MainWindow validation
group: 13 existing offline-input callbacks together, initialization+negative scopes+error behavior jointly checked

plan.checks: Change valid existing controls without explicit compute click; actual scenario values and fresh report update through existing model. Select a real source-bound enemy: both manual controls remain disabled/hidden and stored values retained; returning to manual restores them.

Existing healer actual current skill cap, 0 and valid positive count; value change reaches current scenario/report. Skill switch clamps only via existing blockSignals and refresh flow; retain potential-vs-actual unknown report limits.
Valid elapsed change on existing E2 Silverash condition updates same native input and estimate base defense; no invented native threshold, use actual frozen talent consumer as oracle.

Both existing bool controls change scenario+conditional components/report without extra click; switching away/back retains bools and defaults. Preserve whole-covered/uncovered assumptions, no new activation clock.
Own counts, recipient attack and deployment stacks each cause fresh matching scenario/report; 0 counts and existing maximum2 boundary; fullcast conditional-subtotal distinction unchanged.

Declared count updates condition reference. Existing 0-window positive count error clears numerical result and displays existing error; correcting existing input restores a valid current result without changing mechanism.

Declared break count update; toggle explicit duration on/off updates inclusion immediately and retains setEnabled behavior; duration edit while enabled updates scenario. Off omits skill_duration_seconds and preserves saved numeric value; unknown natural ammo end/conditional distinction unchanged.

Real complete MainWindow with temporary state has same defaults/bounds, no early access to not-created output controls; placeholder/unimplemented/no-skill paths clear current result and show statuses. Record actual automatic calculate/API returns, do not equate operation count to entry count.

Read temporary run/account state snapshots and files before/after focused UI controls: no new run ID/history/resource/observation writes; no game connection/start/capture/chat/schedules. The constructor and original handlers must be isolated instead of claiming globally pure.

verification_policy: Relevant existing checks then selected regression by root only after real changes. No author API probes, no replay of old full90/91/new all-skill loop. Full95 remains every-five schedule if sections progress.
